newsitem.title: MEXICO: MEXICO'S TIIE 28-DAY RATE FALLS TO 20.38 PCT. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: MEXICO'S TIIE 28-DAY RATE FALLS TO 20.38 PCT. [CORRECTED 18:50 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline to read rate falls rather than rises.)
Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Wednesday, August 13, was fixed at 20.38 percent, or a fall of 30 basis points from 20.68 percent, the rate for August 12, Banco de Mexico said on Tuesday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day, and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Wednesday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
